newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: HORSE RACING-HUGHES GUIDES COCKNEY LAD TO CHAMPION HURDLES WIN.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-HUGHES GUIDES COCKNEY LAD TO CHAMPION HURDLES WIN.

text.p: Richard Hughes, who mostly rides for flat racing trainer Mick Channon in England, proved himself a capable jumps jockey when he guided Cockney Lad to win the Grade One Europe Champion Hurdle at Leopardstown on Sunday.
"He gave me a great ride and showed great heart to chase and close the gap on the leader after the last," a delighted Hughes said.

Some of the shine was taken off the victory when Hughes was subsequently handed a four day suspension by the Leopardstown stewards for excessive use of the whip. The suspension takes effect from nine days time.

The Aidan O'Brien trained 13-8 favourite Theatreworld, with Ireland champion jockey Charlie Swan on board, looked the winner as he opened up a one-and-a-half length win after jumping the last in the two mile (3.2km) contest.

But a brilliant late drive by Hughes took the Noel Meade trained Cockney Lad from third place to first over the run for home and the jockey had time to wave to the stands as the chestnut gelding landed a one length triumph.
Theatreworld held on for second, two lengths ahead of Noel Meade's second runner, 25-1 chance Dardjini, whose hopes of winning vanished when he made a bad mistake at the last.
Both Cockney Lad and Theatreworld will now be aimed at the Champion Hurdle at the Cheltenham Festival in March.

Earlier Mulligan, David Nicholson's 2-1 chance, made it four wins in a row over fences when he made all the running on his way to a nine-length victory in the Grade Two Arkle Perpetual Challenge Cup run over two miles and one furlong (3.4-km).

Nicholson said the winner, ridden by Adrian Maguire, who arrived at the racecourse only 20 minutes before the start of the race after his flight out of Britain had been delayed by fog, will be aimed for the Arkle Chase at Cheltenham in March.
Ireland's Danoli, the 10-9 ON favourite, was a faller at the second fence.
